- Initial release of ar-dso-discipline skill for reducing days sales outstanding (DSO) and improving receivables collection.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for measuring, invoicing, collections follow-up, and enforcing payment discipline.
- Includes clear criteria for when to activate the skill (late payments, overdue AR) and when not to (instant payment/point of sale).
- Offers a verification checklist to ensure best practices are in place.
- Emphasizes the impact of DSO on cash flow and highlights key red flags to monitor.
